breakdown.summary: A 9.4 s vertical kinetic-typography reel for a motion studio: one word per card, black on off-white or white on near-black, the colours flipping at every cut. 24 cards cut on an accelerating sound pulse (cards of 22 frames at the start, 7-9 frames at the end). The words read as one sentence: 'we don't just edit, we create motion art - impact, visuals, energy, precision, rhythm, vibes, graphics, transitions, ideas, feelings - re-pe-a-t.' The craft is in the timing and the tiny entry animations (blur-in, slide, a liquid reveal, oversized pop-ins), not in footage or colour.
breakdown.hook: f0-89 (00:00:00:00-00:00:02:29): no face, no footage - a single word 'we' blurs into focus on an off-white card (f0-f3), flips to a black card 'we don't' at f22 (00:00:00:22), 'just' slides in at f42 (00:00:01:12), 'just edit' lands huge at f60 (00:00:02:00), 'we' comes back big at f76 (00:00:02:16). 4 cuts in 3 s, each on a sound pulse; the sentence is left open ('we don't just edit...') so the viewer waits for the payoff. No voice, no caption: the type IS the message.
structure: f0-90 (00:00:00:00-00:00:03:00) setup: 'we / we don't / just / just edit / we' - 5 cards, 22 > 15 frames each, flat backgrounds
f91-118 (00:00:03:01-00:00:03:28) payoff 1: 'create' (liquid reveal, f91-95) and 'motion' (oversized pop-in, f105) - the studio's promise

f119-233 (00:00:03:29-00:00:07:23) the list: 'art / impact / visuals / energy / precision / rhythm / vibes / graphics / transitions / ideas / feelings' - 11 cards of 13 > 9 frames with animated speckle grain, every word pops in ~7-14 % oversized and settles in 2-5 frames
f234-274 (00:00:07:24-00:00:09:04) the stutter ending: 're / repe. / repea / repeat.' typed one card at a time, colours flipping, then 'repeat.' inverted at f267 (00:00:08:27)
f275-281 (00:00:09:05-00:00:09:11) outro: the word blurs out, 6 blank off-white frames
breakdown.captions: None: the words on the cards are the whole content. One word (or two) per card, lower-case, a heavy geometric sans (Futura / Montserrat-like, bold, tight tracking), centred (the first five cards vary: 'just' top-left, 'we don't' / 'just edit' as two-line blocks with the key word 3x bigger). Colour flips every card: #050306 text on #f7f5f8 or the reverse. No outline, no shadow, no box.
text_graphics: entry blur-in: 'we' f0-3 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:03), 'we don't' f22-24 (00:00:00:22-00:00:00:24) - directional blur settling in 3-4 frames
slide-in with motion blur: 'just' f42-43 (00:00:01:12-00:00:01:13) from the left
liquid / wave reveal: 'create' f91-95 (00:00:03:01-00:00:03:05), the signature (E005)
oversized pop-in (scale 1.07-1.16 > 1.0, decelerating, 2-5 frames): 'motion' f105 (00:00:03:15), then every list word from 'visuals' f142 (00:00:04:22) to 're' f234 (00:00:07:24) - E006, E008-E017
hard pop with no animation: 'just edit' f60, 'we' f76, 'art' f119, 'impact' f131, 'repe.' f241, 'repea' f250, 'repeat.' f258
invert: 'repeat.' flips to its negative at f267 (00:00:08:27) (E019); blur-out exit at f275 (00:00:09:05)
animated speckle grain (small bright points on dark cards, dark points on light cards, new every frame) only on f119-233 (00:00:03:29-00:00:07:23)
breakdown.sound: No voice. A single pulsing tone / tick, one pulse per card, the pulses accelerating (19-20 frames apart at the start, 8-9 at the end; 105 BPM is only the average, there is no steady beat). Every cut lands 0-2 frames after a pulse, i.e. the picture is cut to the sound design, not to a music grid. No drops, no builds measured.
breakdown.cta: None spoken or written; the last card 'repeat.' is the tag line. A studio showreel teaser - the CTA lives in the caption / profile.
breakdown.transitions: All 23 are hard cuts (f22, 42, 60, 76, 91, 105, 119, 131, 142, 155, 166, 177, 187, 197, 207, 216, 225, 234, 241, 250, 258, 267, 276), each one a flip of background colour (off-white <> near-black), which makes every cut read as a flash. The 11 'zoom transitions' the lab found are not transitions: the outgoing card is still (x1.00) and only the incoming word scales down into place. The one real transition device is the invert at f267 (00:00:08:27).
breakdown.camera: None - all cards are flat 2D graphics; the only motion is on the text layers (blur, slide, scale, warp) - origin post everywhere.
breakdown.grade: No grade: pure #f7f5f8 off-white and #050306 near-black, saturation 1.7 %. colour.json's 'saturated' / 'vignette' / 'soft highlights' words on the dark cards are wrong - they come from the speckle grain on a black card, not from a look. Rebuild: Background nodes with exactly these two colours; do not grade.
breakdown.rhythm: 134 cuts/min, median card 0.37 s. Card lengths in frames: 22, 20, 18, 16, 15, 14, 14, 12, 11, 13, 11, 11, 10, 10, 10, 9, 9, 9, 7, 9, 8, 9, 8 - an accelerando that follows the sound pulse exactly (onsets at f0.6, 19.9, 40.4, 57.5, 73.8, 88.6, 104, 116.8, 129.8, 142, 153.9, 164.2, 174.8, 186.3, 197.6, 206.4, 216.4, 224.7, 234.1, 242.9, 251.9, 259.7, 267.5, 275.7; cuts 0-2.5 frames after each). The lab's '10 % of cuts on the beat' measures against a fixed 105 BPM grid, which the sound does not keep - against the onsets 23 of 23 cuts are on the pulse.
rebuild_tips: Write the sentence first, then split it into 20-25 cards of one word (two where a small word sets up a big one: 'we / don't', 'just / edit'); keep the words lower-case and the font one heavy geometric sans from the font library (fonts.py list: a Montserrat / Poppins Bold is the closest).
Make the sound before the picture: one tick / whoosh per card from sfx.py, spaced 0.7 s at the start down to 0.27 s at the end; then cut every card on its tick (0-2 frames after it).
Alternate the background colour on every cut (off-white #f7f5f8 / near-black #050306, text in the other) - that flip is what makes a hard cut feel like a flash without any flash.

Give the list words one entry: Transform Size 1.12 > 1.0 in 3-4 frames, ease out (strong); keep 1-2 special entries for the key words (a directional blur-in for the first word, a Displace / wave reveal fading over 5 frames for the promise word).
End with a stutter: type the last word one or two letters per card ('re / repe. / repea / repeat.'), then flip it to its negative with an Invert for 8 frames and blur it out in 1-2 frames.
Add animated speckle grain (Fast Noise, tiny points, ~10-15 %, Seethe on) only in the middle section so the start and the ending stay clean; no grade, no colour.
